decision: Accept only the two exact accessToken nullability changes below. The user explicitly authorized opaque HttpOnly browser/admin/impersonation sessions in the existing API and stated there are no existing external clients to preserve. ADR 0058 records removal of browser JWTs; bot and explicit Telegram Mini App bearer contracts remain supported. No unrelated compatibility exception is granted.
clientRollout: Apply the nullable BrowserSecurityVersion migration first, then release matching API, user/admin SDK bundles and the admin same-origin API proxy together. Ordinary browser and impersonation responses omit JWTs and restore through POST auth/session. Reauthenticate older browser bundles; do not add a legacy browser JWT fallback. Verify independent devices, scoped logout, SSO, isolated support tabs and Telegram on the test stand. This record performs no deployment. Baseline is the latest successful ancestral master push CI run observed on 2026-10-25; changed baseline or snapshots require a fresh exact review.
